name: Millbrook
opening: Millbrook's windmill stands silent for the first time in a hundred years. A freckled girl in a flour-dusted apron runs up to you and points at huge, wet footprints pressed into the wheat. 'Papa went to check the wheel three days ago,' she says. 'He never came back.'
picture: medium shot, (a freckled girl in a flour-dusted apron pointing at huge wet footprints in a golden wheat field, talking to the hero:1.25), (still windmill on a hill behind:1.1), morning light
background: a golden wheat field beside a still wooden windmill and a little thatched village
beats: Follow the strange tracks through the wheat fields
style: morning watercolour, soft greens and gold
secret: A lonely river troll took the miller to fix its broken water wheel.

cast.Pip, the miller's daughter: a freckled girl with two braids and a flour-dusted apron
